$description: PointSav brand semantic-layer override — maps semantic roles (interactive-primary, surface-elevated, ink-primary) to primitive references. SMB customers fork this file as themes/<their-brand>.json and re-point the references at their own primitive values.

ink-placeholder.$description: neutral-60 — 5.27:1 vs surface-base (AA). Was neutral-50 (3.33:1, real AA failure — corrected 2026-07-17); shares no value with ink-disabled since disabled text is WCAG-exempt (1.4.3) but placeholder text is not.

border-strong.$description: neutral-50 — 3.33:1 vs surface-base (AA non-text, WCAG 1.4.11). Was neutral-40 (2.18:1, real failure — corrected 2026-07-17; used as the resting-state border on select/input-text/checkbox and the off-state track fill on switch, all real required control boundaries, not decorative). Matches the dark theme's own border-strong, which already used this same neutral-50 step.

orgchart.$description: orgchart.* semantic namespace -- entity-role colors for corporate hierarchy visualization. Parallel to the wiki.* namespace.

corporate-holding.$description: Primary group entity; top-level holding company

investment-vehicle.$description: Investment unit; investor box; capital receiver

broker-dealer.$description: Registered intermediary -- broker-dealer, asset manager, or regulatory intermediary

equity-partner.$description: Named equity partner, individual principal, or operating entity

admin-entity.$description: Administrative entity -- titleco, support company, service vehicle

fund-vehicle.$description: Limited partnership, fund LP, fideicomiso -- always rendered as dashed pill

legacy-corporate.$description: Legacy entity A -- predecessor corporate structure prior to reorganization

legacy-asset.$description: Legacy entity B -- predecessor asset-holding structure prior to reorganization

dark.$description: Dark mode semantic overrides — applied via [data-theme='dark'] on the root element. Maps the same semantic roles as theme.semantic to dark-optimised primitive values. Wiki surfaces verified: contrast targets WCAG 2.2 AA minimum for all text pairs.

surface-base.$description: neutral-90 — wiki page background in dark mode

surface-elevated.$description: neutral-80 — card, panel, sidebar surface in dark mode

surface-subtle.$description: between neutral-80 and neutral-90 — subtle dividers, table rows

surface-inverse.$description: neutral-10 — inverted surface (light chip on dark page)

surface-code.$description: near-black — code block background; darker than page to create depth

ink-primary.$description: neutral-10 — primary text on dark surface; 14.5:1 vs surface-base

ink-disabled.$description: neutral-70 — disabled text on dark surface

ink-on-inverse.$description: neutral-100 — text on light chip within dark page

border-subtle.$description: neutral-70 — hairline borders on dark surface

border-interactive.$description: primary-40 — input border, interactive element outline on dark bg

focus-ring.$description: primary-40 — focus ring; 5.59:1 vs surface-base (AA non-text; corrected 2026-07-15, was mislabeled 3.1:1)

interactive-primary.$description: primary-60 — button fill; 6.66:1 with white text (fixed 2026-07-15: was primary-50 at a hair's-width 4.53:1 pass with a wrong 4.8:1 description; moved to match light theme's own resting value for a real safety margin)

interactive-primary-hover.$description: primary-70 — hover state on dark; 9.22:1 with white text (fixed 2026-07-15: was primary-40, a real AA failure at 2.88:1 — dark mode was lightening on hover instead of darkening, the opposite of light theme's own pattern)

interactive-primary-pressed.$description: primary-80 — pressed state on dark; 12.77:1 with white text (added 2026-07-15: this token had no entry anywhere in this governed source at all — only a hand-added, non-compliant value in the generated CSS at 1.87:1, a severe real AA failure)

interactive-ghost-hover.$description: semi-transparent white — ghost button hover on dark

interactive-ghost-pressed.$description: semi-transparent white — ghost button press on dark

support-critical.$description: critical-30 — error text on dark background (AA)

support-critical-bg.$description: dark critical tint — error banner fill on dark page

support-caution.$description: caution-30 — warning text on dark background

support-caution-bg.$description: dark caution tint — warning banner fill on dark page

support-positive.$description: positive-30 — success text on dark background

wiki-link.$description: primary-30 — wiki hyperlink on dark page; 8.64:1 vs surface-base, 6.41:1 vs surface-elevated (AA on both; corrected 2026-07-17 — the prior primary-40 value only verified against surface-base and failed at 4.15:1 against surface-elevated, the card/panel/sidebar surface this token is also used against in dark mode)

wiki-redlink.$description: critical-30 — wiki red (missing) link on dark page

wiki-code-keyword.$description: caution-30 — syntax highlight keyword on dark code block

wiki-code-string.$description: positive-30 — syntax highlight string literal on dark code block

wiki-code-comment.$description: neutral-50 — syntax highlight comment on dark code block

accessibility.motion_respect: prefers-reduced-motion honored at all interaction layers

wcag-target.$description: WCAG conformance target for this design system

contrast-floor-text.$description: Minimum contrast ratio, body text against its surface

contrast-floor-focus-ring.$description: Minimum contrast ratio, focus ring against its surface

motion-respect.$value: prefers-reduced-motion honored at all interaction layers
